title: AUTH-431: Mass token expiration during Redis failover
root_cause: Redis cluster failover caused token validation cache miss. Token refresh has no retry logic — all tokens expired silently.
resolution: Sarah manually restarted token validation service and flushed stale cache entries.

title: PLAT-118: API gateway 502 errors under peak load
root_cause: Connection pool exhaustion on API gateway due to upstream service timeout misconfiguration.
resolution: Increased connection pool limits and adjusted upstream timeout from 30s to 10s with circuit breaker.

title: AUTH-445: MFA verification timeouts for enterprise tier
root_cause: TOTP validation service hit rate limit on HSM calls during morning login surge.
resolution: Sarah adjusted HSM call batching and increased rate limit threshold for TOTP validation.

title: PAY-201: Stripe webhook delivery failures
root_cause: Webhook endpoint SSL certificate expired. Automated renewal failed due to DNS propagation delay.
resolution: Manually renewed certificate and updated DNS records. Added cert expiry monitoring alert.

title: AUTH-512: Session fixation vulnerability in mobile OAuth flow
root_cause: Mobile OAuth flow reused session identifiers across token refresh cycles, allowing session fixation.
resolution: Sarah deployed hotfix to regenerate session ID on every token refresh for mobile clients.

title: PLAT-134: GraphQL query timeout on analytics endpoint
root_cause: Unbounded nested query on analytics resolver caused N+1 query explosion against Postgres.
resolution: Added query depth limiting and DataLoader batching to analytics resolver.

title: AUTH-621: JWT signature validation failure after key rotation
root_cause: Automated key rotation published new signing key but JWKS endpoint cache TTL caused 30-min stale window.
resolution: Sarah invalidated CDN cache for JWKS endpoint and reduced cache TTL from 1h to 5min.

title: INFRA-044: Kubernetes node pool OOM during batch processing
root_cause: Batch processing job memory limits not set, causing node-level OOM when processing large tenant exports.
resolution: Added memory limits to batch job specs and configured horizontal pod autoscaler.

title: AUTH-892: Enterprise SSO login failures for 200+ clients
root_cause: SAML certificate rotation triggered by vendor without notice. Fallback cert path not configured.
resolution: Sarah manually imported new vendor cert and configured dual-cert validation. Mike coordinated client comms.

title: PAY-219: Subscription renewal charges duplicated
root_cause: Idempotency key generation used timestamp with insufficient precision, causing duplicate charges under concurrent renewals.
resolution: Switched idempotency key to UUID v4 and issued automatic refunds for 34 affected customers.

title: AUTH-934: Rate limiter blocking legitimate enterprise traffic
root_cause: Per-IP rate limiting miscounted requests behind enterprise proxy, treating entire org as single client.
resolution: Sarah added X-Forwarded-For awareness to rate limiter and created enterprise IP allowlist.

title: PLAT-156: Webhook delivery latency spike to 45s
root_cause: Redis pub/sub channel backpressure from unacknowledged messages caused webhook queue to back up.
resolution: Cleared stuck messages and added dead-letter queue for undeliverable webhooks.

title: AUTH-1078: Cross-tenant token leakage in shared cache
root_cause: Cache key generation omitted tenant ID prefix under specific race condition during cache rebuild after failover.
resolution: Sarah patched cache key generation to always include tenant scope and invalidated all active sessions as precaution.

title: INFRA-067: Database connection pool saturation
root_cause: Long-running analytics queries held connections indefinitely due to missing statement timeout.
resolution: Added statement_timeout of 30s to analytics connection pool and killed zombie connections.

title: AUTH-1205: Random user logouts in production
root_cause: Token refresh deadlock under cache partition. Same underlying issue as AUTH-431.
resolution: Sarah applied same manual cache flush workaround. Noted this is the third recurrence of the token refresh gap.

title: PAY-248: Invoice generation failing for annual plans
root_cause: Tax calculation API changed response format without versioning. Annual invoice template parsing broke.
resolution: Pinned tax API to v2 response format and added schema validation on external API responses.

title: AUTH-1302: Permission escalation via stale RBAC cache
root_cause: RBAC permission cache not invalidated on role change. Users retained elevated permissions for up to 1 hour.
resolution: Sarah added cache invalidation hook on role mutation and reduced RBAC cache TTL to 60 seconds.

title: PLAT-178: API versioning header ignored causing breaking changes
root_cause: Middleware ordering change caused API version header to be stripped before reaching router.
resolution: Fixed middleware chain ordering and added integration test for version header propagation.

title: AUTH-1547: OAuth callback failures after deployment
root_cause: Retry logic deployment was reverted due to race condition. Original bug persists.
resolution: Sarah rolled back to previous stable version. Token refresh retry remains unimplemented.

title: INFRA-089: CDN cache poisoning from malformed headers
root_cause: CDN edge nodes cached error responses due to missing Vary header on auth endpoints.
resolution: Added appropriate Vary and Cache-Control headers. Purged affected CDN edge locations.
